name: Prepare pinned original Porpoise fonts, buttons and sounds
run:
set -euo pipefail
rev=2ed1ab5a06995aa198f7bccd4da0f90c3fc29d39
root=ps5/porpoise_original/assets
mkdir -p "$root/fonts" "$root/brand" "$root/ui" "$root/sounds" ps5/frontend/assets/porpoise ps5/frontend/assets/sounds
for spec in \
  'fonts/Nunito-Regular.ttf 2f4a2f8467657c1f039800f7af0f85d719d92bf6' \
  'fonts/Nunito-SemiBold.ttf 2588d394a7b5773e8355c1d923877bef338f2adf' \
  'fonts/Nunito-Bold.ttf c642a28adb3b5b89bc37dca9b76b81fa114c022b' \
  'fonts/Nunito-ExtraBold.ttf 5dab2fd42d061b7f69ecbee7ac3f73d50053978c' \
  'fonts/NotoSansJP-Porpoise.ttf e18162d7dd500a08d301b91949c6aa9a0c94907e' \
  'brand/dolphin-mask.png bd51e74f7e11c79de9d40d626d3685038cf5d792' \
  'ui/buttons.png 43902f0bccdab08fb74efb0a99ae3f282299543a' \
  'sounds/game-row.wav d10d7d6ef5f8cb7343539e8aafb57fcb49f90a0f' \
  'sounds/menu-scroll.wav abab02c03a9a8181f3c81ad6d027de6b9940213a'; do
  read -r name expected <<< "$spec"
  curl -fL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 20 \
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/elripalda/Porpoise-Dolphin-Emulator-for-PS5/$rev/assets/$name" -o "$root/$name"
  test "$(git hash-object "$root/$name")" = "$expected"
done
cp -R "$root/fonts" "$root/ui" ps5/frontend/assets/porpoise/
cp "$root/sounds/"*.wav ps5/frontend/assets/sounds/
mkdir -p ps5/porpoise_original/src/stb
cp ps5/frontend/third_party/stb_image.h ps5/porpoise_original/src/stb/stb_image.h
cp ps5/frontend/third_party/stb_truetype.h ps5/porpoise_original/src/stb/stb_truetype.h
python3 ps5/porpoise_original/tools/rebuild_shader.py
test -s ps5/porpoise_original/src/ui_frag.inc
